23dc4fe3da5f475845aa16267bd0127ee6a4015b.QuestDescription: This book is written in the pig-tongue the humans use.  It needs to be burned immediately.$B$BHand it to my sister Gorgonna and do not waste my time.

23df698cd7476b5d346ae2108422d5656fe9b2e8.LogDescription: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Alexi Barov when you have completed this task.
23df698cd7476b5d346ae2108422d5656fe9b2e8.QuestDescription: Within the Scholomance lays the Barov family fortune. I, Alexi Barov, am one of the last two remaining heirs of the house Barov. My brother, Weldon, is the other.$B$BWeldon, the miserable coward, fled during the war and thus retained his worthless existence as a human.$B$BHe now searches for the deeds so that he may claim the fortune for his own. Recover the deeds before my brother does and I shall make you wealthy beyond your wildest dreams!

23e6232dec10c07d911a553c1f9087d79630b243.Text: I shall transform my familiar, Sagan, into something truly wondrous!

23e6ebb677f128eb946749129faea3dec356ea2f.OptionText: I wish to unlearn my talents.

23e8bf9c60a3334e9a16b2b3d559e04d727ee178.LogDescription: King Mrgl-Mrgl has given you a conch to use upon Scalder's remains. Return The King's Filled Conch to him at Winterfin Retreat.
23e8bf9c60a3334e9a16b2b3d559e04d727ee178.QuestDescription: To help, you must learn how to speak the Winterfin dialect. We'll work with the forces of nature and magic to do that.$B$BTake this empty conch shell. At the bottom of the watery trench below exists Scalder, an elemental of air and watery fury.$B$BOnce she is defeated, use the conch upon her remains to capture her magical steam. Return the full conch to me, and I'll imbue my knowledge of the Winterfin tongue into you.$B$BLuckily, a friend taught me a water breathing spell, which I will cast upon you.

23ea0f014fd2f223f21b81187add3ab0b4bbde4e.RewardText: <Thassarian nods.>$B$BGood. It's not much protection, but it's better than nothing. That gate is still the perfect choke point if the Scourge commanders know what they're doing. We must gain control of as much of the surrounding area as possible.

23f0d128d1a1793ebebfa9725e342e91a45095f3.CompletionText: It's simple really. You're sent out to kill four incompetent fools that are likely to blab all of our secrets anytime now, and you go out and do it.$B$B<The high executor puts on an unholy grin.>

23fdacbdfb69fec2597fbc7803b75dbe9f9cf0e0.LogDescription: Investigate the Strange Object next to the Broken Corpse to determine what might have befallen the Cenarion Thicket.  Then return to Earthbinder Tavgren just outside the thicket in Terokkar Forest.
23fdacbdfb69fec2597fbc7803b75dbe9f9cf0e0.QuestDescription: I have no idea what killed all of the druids here.  I've been away for a couple of days on a survey of the Bone Wastes to the south.$B$BPlease, you must help me to uncover what's behind this horrible tragedy.  Go into the thicket and look for a clue that might reveal something to us.  When I was in there briefly, I could have sworn I saw a dead Broken and a strange object next to him.$B$B And don't worry about Treelos - he might have been driven insane by what happened, but I think he's mostly harmless.

23fe37a0ba571f3f7903b50efaba038637d48973.LogDescription: Bring your Violet Signet to Archmage Leryda at Deadwind Pass after obtaining Honored reputation with the Violet Eye.
23fe37a0ba571f3f7903b50efaba038637d48973.QuestDescription: You've chosen your path, $c.  Now it is up to you to travel the path to wherever it may lead.$B$BYou will find that having friends among the Archmages of Dalaran has its advantages.  Serve us well and your deeds will not go unrewarded.
